review_description: The quoting needed to be more thorough as we had to spend more $ over the quoted price.
His paperwork is terrible, never checked labourers work in ceiling, wiring in ceiling not up to satisfactory standard, agreed to come back and fix, 2 months passed and no sight of him.

The solar system that I have decided to have installed is a solar system with battery back up which will give me a total of 3.7 kW and will make me almost totally independant from the grid.So, it won`t matter if in the future the government decides to do away with the rebates like they have in Germany, I will be able to get enough power from the solar system with battery back up to run my home and with little to no power bills.
Great service, was installed with minimum delay and the installers were very knowledgeable and helpful.
The Guys turned up when they said they would, system has been running well for over a month now. Happy with decision to buy from them.
Thanks for your guidance in helping me with choosing a company. They were very professional in all they did & we would recommend them to all who want a job well done .
